title: Construction & trades
_note: English for work (english-for-work run, 2026-11-02): written by hand in British English, not yet checked by a second reader. translations.en = short definition in simple English; deHint = German translation (the 'German' tab). Words that already exist in the English lexicon are refs with a job-specific example.
intro: The words for work on a building site or in a trade: tools and materials, jobs on site, instructions, safety and talking to customers and the team. Every word has an example sentence from a real working day in the UK.
introEasy: Do you work on a building site or in a trade? Learn the words for tools, jobs and safety here.
tipps: Site talk is short and direct: “Pass me the hammer”, “Hold that for a second”, “Mind your head!” Do not worry about being too blunt – it is normal and friendly.
If you do not know a word for a tool or material, point and ask: “What do you call this?” Workmates like to explain, and you learn fast.
In a customer's home, be polite and tidy. Say what you will do, ask before you move things, and say “Sorry about the mess” when you finish for the day.
